mentl/9ae48a2:
Four findings, one law: a fact copied out of the structure that holds it
rots there, and every one of these was found by a comment that had gone
false in the file being touched.

persist no longer copies the image. The wire used to be built by
allocating a second image-sized buffer and mem_copy'ing the whole heap
into it so a String could be handed to the persist op; both callers
wrote that String straight to a file and dropped it, and the bytes were
already contiguous at [0, size). image_header builds the bounded header
at the perform site — which the op's own decl requires, because
globals_save captures $world_g and an arm's world excludes its own
handler — and the extent streams from address 0.

That copy is why the wheel was never incremental. Doubling the footprint
crossed the allocator's signed-2GB bound, so driver_warm_persist carried
a 960MB capacity gate, so a ~2.3GB judgment sat permanently above it and
NEVER persisted once. Every self-compile derived cold and said so in one
line that read like a note. The gate is deleted; a program that could
not persist before now writes a complete 118,863,200-byte image, its
declared extent equal to its file size.

The wheel still cannot, and the reason is measured rather than inferred:
its judgment line is 2,268,065,808 bytes, which is negative as a signed
word. 98% of that is scratch, so the ceiling falls with the image/scratch
split, never with a wider integer.

A short write now leaves NO image. driver_warm_ready admits on
byte_len >= 16 plus the build key, both of which live in the header, so
a header-only file was indistinguishable from a whole one and would have
restored a declared extent that was never written. The all-or-nothing
write is one filesystem operation with one home: fs_write_image_impl in
io.mn owns the open/write/write/close/unlink, which is also why the
effect-seam ratchet tightens 9 -> 8 instead of rising.

The field-offset floor reports for the first time. report() derives a
diagnostic's module f

mentl/9a44da1:
The fan and the e-graph are duals over two spaces, not one mechanism
and not two features. Meaning-space is explored by forking, form-space
by merging: the fan's candidates conflict so each needs isolation, the
e-graph's members are equal by construction so merging needs none —
which is why one required the whole trail-and-spawn substrate and the
other runs free inside lower. Proof is a filter over meaning, cost an
order over form. A tie in form-space is free; a tie in meaning-space is
a question, which derives rather than asserts where the human is
irreplaceable — the teaching tie-break is what the fork side IS when it
ends with more than one survivor. The order is forced: extract-then-
prove would optimize an inadmissible program. And the effect row gates
both halves, rewrite-legality and candidate-legality, one algebra at
two altitudes. State stated honestly: designed, not built.
